items.question: According to the UAE Foreign Direct Investment Report 2025, how much did foreign direct investment inflows to the UAE reach in 2024?
items.fact: UAE FDI inflows reached USD 45.6 billion in 2024

items.question: What legal forms can foreign direct investment projects take in the UAE?
items.gold: Public joint stock company, private joint stock company, limited liability company, limited partnership company, and partnership company.
items.fact: Five legal forms available for UAE foreign direct investment projects
